title: Soft-Sentinel: policy-driven safe-exit + state-heal for config changes
creator: Marco Nguyen
description:
Problem: config changes to serving runtime (batching, cache TTLs, routing policies) sometimes cause subtle cost regressions or tail latency spikes that escape standard unit tests. Current auto-revert tooling is brittle: immediate hard rollbacks can cause thrash, and simple thresholds lack context about transient load patterns or gradual drift.

Goal: implement a Soft-Sentinel layer that automatically evaluates config mutations through a staged safe-exit policy and state-reconciliation flow. The system should: 1) run a gated dry-run / staging probe before full apply, 2) monitor multi-signal economic and SLO indicators, 3) execute bounded, staged rollbacks (gradual drain, not immediate kill), and 4) reconcile state (KV caches, batch queues, routing tables) to a known-good snapshot when rollback completes. The system will prioritize availability and avoid oscillation while minimizing cost exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Soft-Sentinel snapshots pre-change state and stores a compact state-diff that can be used for targeted reconciliation
Config changes run a configurable probe window (default 7 minutes) in parallel shadow mode before full traffic switch
Rollback is executed as a three-stage safe-exit: throttled disable -> phased drain -> final revert, with max rollback duration configurable
Economic guard triggers (cost-per-token delta, sustained > 10% for 5m) and SLO triggers (p95 latency + error rate) both supported and combinable
No customer requests are served from untracked rollout slots during reconciliation; KV cache rehydration runs without serving staleness beyond 20s for pinned keys
Automated reconciliation runbook emits deterministic steps for manual intervention and a one-click revert in Console
Integration tests simulate load patterns and assert rollback avoids greater-than-2x request loss compared to pre-change baseline
tasks: Spec: finalise sentinel policy DSL (economic, latency, error, drift thresholds)
Implement probe-shadow harness to run config under limited traffic and collect metric deltas
Snapshot & compact-state exporter for KV cache and routing table
Safe-exit orchestration API (throttled disable, phased drain, revert apply) and state reconciliation executor
Console: expose sentinel policy editor / one-click abort + visibility for probe results
E2E test harness (load generator + synthetic cost model + fail-injection)
Security: KMS access review for state snapshot storage and retention policy
